verdict.rationale: The only webhook-related evidence (mastra-docs-18) describes inbound ingestion: agent threads subscribe to external resources, and incoming webhook or polling events are routed into notification signals. Nothing documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that a programmatic consumer could subscribe to for Mastra events. Inbound webhook handling is an adjacent capability, not delivery of this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
